name: +1 Paint Keyboard Adventure
desc:
⚡ Welcome to +1 Paint Keyboard Adventure!

How to Play:
🎨 Run across keyboards and paint the keys
👟 Every key you paint makes you faster
🏆 Complete keyboards to get wins
💪 Upgrade your Range to paint more keys
🔥 Rebirth to push your limits

If you’re having fun, don't forget to like the game! 👍
